instagram.caption:
The third frying pan.
The Lower Cabinet and Cookware Zone in the Kitchen. Deep, low storage for the heavy pieces: pots, pans, lids, bakeware, and the big bowls.

What done looks like:
1. Every pan comes out and goes back in one motion
2. Pans nested no more than three deep or stood on edge in a divider, lids in a rack or on a door rail instead of loose, baking sheets standing on end, and the two pans you cook with nightly at the front of the cabinet nearest the hob
3. Nothing has to come out to reach anything else

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success lower cabinet and cookware zone.
